meals.name: One-Pot Creamy Chicken and Rice Bake
meals.description: Tender chicken thigh fillets nestled in fluffy rice, simmered in a creamy stock with sweetcorn and peas for a comforting all-in-one supper.

meals.name: Chicken and Rice Soup with Carrot and Celery
meals.description: A warming, brothy soup with shredded chicken, soft rice and plenty of vegetables, finished with a squeeze of lemon and fresh parsley.

meals.name: Chicken Biryani-Style Spiced Rice
meals.description: Fragrant, mildly spiced rice layered with golden chicken, sweet onions and warming spices, topped with yoghurt and coriander for a cosy, aromatic dinner.

meals.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken and Rice
meals.description: Tender chicken thigh fillets baked with fluffy rice, lemon and garlic in a single pot, finished with peas and fresh parsley for a comforting weeknight supper.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Soup
meals.description: A warming, velvety soup full of shredded chicken, carrot, celery and rice, perfect for chasing away the rainy-day chill.

meals.name: Baked Chicken and Rice Bake with Cheesy Broccoli
meals.description: Juicy chicken thighs roasted on a bed of tomato-spiced rice with broccoli and a golden melted cheddar topping.

meals.name: One-Pot Lemon Chicken and Rice
meals.description: Tender chicken thigh fillets simmered with fluffy rice, sweet carrots and peas in a gently lemony stock. All cooked in one pot for a comforting, low-fuss supper.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Rice Bake
meals.description: A bubbling oven bake of chicken breast and rice in a creamy sauce with sweetcorn and broccoli, topped with golden melted cheddar. Pure rainy-day comfort.

meals.name: Chicken, Ginger and Spring Onion Rice Soup
meals.description: A soothing, warming bowl of rice simmered in a gingery chicken broth with shredded chicken, carrot and spinach. Perfect for a damp evening.

meals.name: Butternut Squash and Cashew Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Silky, golden macaroni in a velvety sauce of roasted-sweet butternut squash and cashews, boosted with nutritional yeast for a cheesy flavour. Pure comfort on a chilly night, and completely dairy-free.

meals.name: Baked Potato and Carrot 'Cheese' Macaroni with Crispy Crumb Top
meals.description: A creamy sauce made from blended potato, carrot and onion coats the pasta, which is then baked with a golden, crunchy breadcrumb topping. Smoky, cosy and ideal for a cold evening.

meals.name: Smoky Bacon, Leek and Pea Mac and Cheese
meals.description: Macaroni in a rich, creamy white sauce made with oat milk and melting dairy-free cheese, studded with crispy bacon, soft leeks and sweet peas. A hearty hob-top supper that warms you right through.

meals.name: Butternut Squash and Cashew Mac 'Cheese'
meals.description: Silky, golden sauce of roasted-soft butternut squash blended with cashews and nutritional yeast for a rich, cheesy flavour, all without any dairy. Pure comfort on a cold evening.

meals.name: Baked Broccoli Mac with Crispy Breadcrumb Topping
meals.description: Macaroni and tender broccoli folded into a creamy oat milk béchamel boosted with nutritional yeast and mustard, then baked under a golden, crunchy breadcrumb crust.

meals.name: One-Pot Smoky Chicken and Sweetcorn Mac
meals.description: Macaroni simmered with chicken in creamy coconut milk, smoked paprika and nutritional yeast for a cosy, cheesy-tasting supper that cooks in a single pan.

meals.name: Butternut Squash and Cashew Mac 'n' Cheese
meals.description: Silky, golden dairy-free sauce made from roasted-sweet butternut squash and blended cashews, with a savoury cheesy kick from nutritional yeast. Pure comfort for a chilly night.

meals.name: Baked Potato and Carrot 'Cheese' Mac with Broccoli
meals.description: A creamy sauce of blended potato and carrot coats macaroni and tender broccoli, finished with a golden, crunchy smoked paprika breadcrumb topping from the oven.

meals.name: Creamy White Bean Mac with Crispy Bacon and Peas
meals.description: Cannellini beans blitzed with garlic and oat milk make a velvety, cheesy-tasting sauce, tossed through pasta with salty crispy bacon and sweet peas. Quick and cosy.

meals.name: Ultimate Cheesy Beef Lasagne
meals.description: Layers of rich beef and tomato ragù, silky cornflour white sauce and gluten-free pasta sheets, topped with a bubbling golden blanket of cheddar and mozzarella. Grated carrot melts into the sauce for a little hidden veg.

meals.name: Creamy Spinach, Ricotta and Courgette Lasagne
meals.description: A gooey vegetarian lasagne with a creamy ricotta and spinach layer, soft courgette and a rich tomato sauce, all finished with stretchy melted mozzarella. Made with gluten-free pasta sheets.

meals.name: One-Pan Cheesy Lasagne Pasta
meals.description: All the flavours of lasagne without the layering: turkey mince, sweet pepper and gluten-free fusilli simmered in tomato sauce, then smothered in melted cheese. Everything cooks in one pan for a speedy midweek win.

meals.name: Ultimate Cheesy Beef Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: A classic family lasagne with a rich hidden-veg beef ragù, a silky cheese sauce and a bubbling mozzarella top, made with gluten-free sheets.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Spinach Cheese Lasagne (Gluten-Free)
meals.description: Tender chicken, mushrooms and wilted spinach layered with gluten-free pasta sheets and a golden cheddar and Parmesan sauce. A mild white lasagne that's perfect for fussy eaters.

meals.name: Cheesy Sweet Potato and Turkey Lasagne Bake
meals.description: A pasta-free lasagne with layers of thinly sliced sweet potato, a sweet tomato and turkey sauce, creamy ricotta and a stretchy cheese top. Naturally gluten-free and loved by kids.

meals.name: Classic Cheesy Beef Lasagne
meals.description: Rich beef and tomato ragù with a hidden grated carrot, layered with gluten-free lasagne sheets, silky cheese sauce and a golden mozzarella and cheddar topping.

meals.name: Creamy Chicken and Sweetcorn White Lasagne
meals.description: A mild, creamy lasagne with tender chicken, sweet sweetcorn and tiny broccoli pieces in a cheesy white sauce, baked until bubbling and golden.

meals.name: Cheesy Ricotta Lasagne Pasta Bake
meals.description: All the flavours of lasagne in an easy bake: gluten-free pasta, turkey and hidden courgette ragù, creamy ricotta and stretchy mozzarella on top.

meals.name: Peanut-Free Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken, crunchy vegetables and flat rice noodles tossed in a creamy, savoury satay-style sauce made with sunflower seed butter, so it is completely nut-free. Mild and family friendly.

meals.name: Creamy Prawn Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Juicy prawns, courgette and sugar snap peas with springy egg noodles in a silky coconut satay sauce enriched with tahini for that rich, nutty-tasting depth without any nuts. Gently spiced for children.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Broccoli Satay Noodles
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu, broccoli and carrot with wide rice noodles in a rich, glossy sunflower seed satay sauce. A hearty vegetarian dinner that is nut-free and mild.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Noodle Stir-Fry with Sunflower Seed Sauce
meals.description: Tender chicken and crunchy vegetables tossed with rice noodles in a creamy, savoury-sweet satay-style sauce. It's made with sunflower seed butter instead of peanuts, so it's nut-free and gently spiced for the whole family.

meals.name: Creamy Sesame Satay Prawn Udon with Pak Choi
meals.description: Juicy prawns and thick, chewy udon noodles coated in a rich, nutty-tasting sauce made with tahini and sunflower seed butter. Pak choi and mushrooms add freshness, and it's mild and nut-free.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Vegetable Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu with broccoli, carrot and beansprouts, tossed through egg noodles in a thick, creamy satay-style sauce. It's a vegetarian, nut-free family supper with a mild, gentle warmth.

meals.name: Chicken Satay Rice Noodle Stir-Fry
meals.description: Tender chicken and crunchy vegetables tossed with flat rice noodles in a creamy, nut-free satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter, soy and lime. Gently spiced so the whole family can enjoy it.

meals.name: Creamy Prawn Satay Egg Noodles
meals.description: Juicy prawns, pak choi and beansprouts with springy egg noodles, coated in a silky satay-style sauce built on tahini for a rich, nut-free finish. Mild and family friendly.

meals.name: Crispy Tofu and Broccoli Satay Udon
meals.description: Golden pan-fried tofu, broccoli and sweet peppers with thick, chewy udon in a rich, savoury satay sauce made with sunflower seed butter. A hearty vegetarian dinner with only a gentle hint of warmth.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Ginger-Soy Peanut Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of raw salmon on sushi rice with cucumber, avocado, edamame beans and radish, finished with a zingy ginger, lime and soy dressing. Peanut oil gives the nutty depth you'd normally get from sesame, without any sesame at all.

meals.name: Teriyaki-Glazed Baked Salmon Rice Bowl
meals.description: Salmon fillets baked with a sticky ginger-soy glaze, served over brown rice with tender broccoli and carrot ribbons. A warm, cooked take on the poke bowl that suits fussier eaters.

meals.name: Smoked Salmon Poke-Style Noodle Bowl with Peanut-Lime Dressing
meals.description: Cool rice noodles topped with flaked hot-smoked salmon, crunchy red cabbage, carrot and cucumber, dressed in a creamy ginger, lime and peanut dressing with fresh coriander. Quick, no-fuss and full of flavour.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Sesame-Free Ginger Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of sushi-grade salmon on seasoned sushi rice with crisp cucumber, creamy avocado and edamame. The zingy ginger-soy dressing gets its nutty richness from a touch of peanut butter instead of sesame.

meals.name: Ginger-Soy Glazed Salmon Rice Bowl
meals.description: Salmon fillets baked with a sticky honey, soy and ginger glaze, served over fluffy rice with tender broccoli and carrot. A cooked, family-friendly take on the poke bowl.

meals.name: Smoked Salmon Poke-Style Soba Bowl
meals.description: A quick, cool noodle bowl with flaked hot-smoked salmon, crunchy red cabbage, cucumber and edamame, tossed in a creamy peanut-ginger dressing with a squeeze of lime.

meals.name: Salmon Poke Bowl with Ginger-Soy Lime Dressing
meals.description: Cubes of fresh salmon on seasoned sushi rice with creamy avocado, crisp cucumber and edamame, finished with a zingy sesame-free ginger-soy dressing.

meals.name: Seared Salmon Rice Bowl with Ginger-Garlic Glaze
meals.description: A warm, cooked take on poke: pan-seared salmon glazed in a sticky ginger-soy sauce, served over rice with garlicky broccoli.

meals.name: Cold Salmon Poke Noodle Bowl with Crunchy Veg
meals.description: Flaked baked salmon over chilled rice noodles with red cabbage, radish and cucumber, tossed in a bright ginger, lime and chilli dressing.

meals.name: Saffron Cod and Red Pepper Paella
meals.description: A classic hob-cooked paella with flaky cod, sweet red pepper and peas on golden saffron rice, finished with a squeeze of lemon.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Asparagus Paella
meals.description: Hands-off paella baked in the oven with rich salmon, tender asparagus and cherry tomatoes, perfect for a relaxed summer weekend.

meals.name: Smoked Haddock, Courgette and Tomato Paella
meals.description: Smoky haddock flakes through tomatoey rice with soft courgette and sweetcorn for a gently smoky, colourful paella.

meals.name: Summer Hake and Pea Paella
meals.description: A classic-style paella with flaky white fish, sweet peas and saffron-scented rice, finished with lemon and parsley. Perfect for a relaxed weekend lunch in the garden.

meals.name: Oven-Baked Salmon and Courgette Paella
meals.description: Golden turmeric rice baked with juicy cherry tomatoes and courgette, topped with tender salmon pieces. A hands-off, mild and family-friendly take on paella.

meals.name: Cod and Chickpea Paella with Roasted Peppers
meals.description: A hearty, smoky one-pan rice dish with chunky cod, chickpeas and sweet peppers in a rich tomato base. Finished with a squeeze of lemon for a fresh summery lift.

meals.name: Saffron Cod and Pea Paella
meals.description: A classic-style summer paella with flaky cod, sweet peppers and peas, all cooked in one pan with smoky paprika and golden saffron rice. Finish with lemon wedges and parsley.

meals.name: Salmon and Green Bean Oven Paella
meals.description: A relaxed, mostly hands-off paella baked in the oven with juicy salmon, green beans and cherry tomatoes. Turmeric and smoked paprika give it colour and warmth.

meals.name: Cold Tuna Paella-Style Rice Salad
meals.description: A cool, zesty rice salad inspired by paella, with tuna, sweet pepper, sweetcorn and olives in a smoky paprika and lemon dressing. Ideal for a hot weekend lunch or a picnic.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara with Smoky Tofu Bacon
meals.description: Silky cashew cream sauce coated in spaghetti, finished with crisp smoked tofu 'bacon' and plenty of black pepper. All the richness of a classic carbonara, entirely plant-based.

meals.name: Creamy Garlic Mushroom Fettuccine Alfredo
meals.description: Ribbons of fettuccine in a velvety oat cream and vegan Parmesan-style sauce with golden garlicky mushrooms. Rich, comforting and perfect for sharing by candlelight.

meals.name: Baked Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crunchy Topping
meals.description: Macaroni in a golden, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and cashews, topped with crisp garlicky breadcrumbs and baked until bubbling. Pure indulgence for a cosy night in.

meals.name: Vegan Cashew Carbonara with Smoky Mushrooms
meals.description: Silky pasta in a rich, creamy cashew and nutritional yeast sauce, topped with crispy smoked mushrooms in place of bacon and finished with plenty of black pepper.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crunchy Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Comforting macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, topped with golden garlicky breadcrumbs.

meals.name: Creamy Lemon Pea and Basil Tagliatelle
meals.description: Ribbons of tagliatelle coated in a luscious cream made from silken tofu, nutritional yeast and lemon, studded with sweet peas and fresh basil.

meals.name: Vegan Mushroom Carbonara with Smoky Tofu Bacon
meals.description: Silky cashew and nutritional yeast sauce coats spaghetti, topped with crisp smoked tofu 'bacon' and a generous grind of black pepper for a rich, indulgent date night classic.

meals.name: Creamy Vegan Mac and Cheese with Crunchy Breadcrumbs
meals.description: Macaroni in a velvety, cheesy sauce made from potato, carrot and nutritional yeast, finished with golden garlicky breadcrumbs. Pure comfort food for two.

meals.name: Creamy Sun-Dried Tomato and Spinach Fettuccine
meals.description: Ribbons of fettuccine tossed in a rich, garlicky cashew cream with sweet sun-dried tomatoes, wilted spinach and a golden sprinkle of vegan parmesan-style crumbs.

meals.name: Õhukesed pannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Õhukesed kuldse servaga pannkoogid, mis rullitakse kokku maasikamoosiga. Taigen on lihtne ja munavaba, pannilt tulevad pannkoogid pehmed ja elastsed.

meals.name: Keefiripannkoogid vaarikamoosiga
meals.description: Paksemad kohevad pannkoogid, mis saavad keefirist kerge hapuka maitse. Peale tuleb hea lusikatäis vaarikamoosi.

meals.name: Banaani-kaerapannkoogid mustikamoosiga
meals.description: Pehmed pannkoogid, mille magusus tuleb küpsest banaanist ja kaerahelbed annavad neile mõnusa tekstuuri. Mustikamoos teeb need hommikusöögilauale eriti ilusaks.

meals.name: Õhukesed pannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Õhukesed kuldse servaga pannkoogid, mis rullid moosiga kokku. Taigen on munavaba ja ikka pehme ning painduv.

meals.name: Lopsakad pannkoogid vaarikamoosiga
meals.description: Paksud ja õhulised pannkoogid, mille peale valad vaarikamoosi. Munaasendajaks on sidrunimahl, mis teeb taigna kohevaks.

meals.name: Banaani-kaerapannkoogid mustikamoosiga
meals.description: Pehmed pannkoogid kaerahelveste ja küpse banaaniga, mis seob taigna ilma munata. Peale lisad mustikamoosi.

meals.name: Õhukesed pannkoogid moosiga
meals.description: Õrnad kuldsed pannkoogid, mis rullitakse magusa moosiga kokku. Taigen on munavaba, aga pannkoogid jäävad ikka pehmeks ja õhukeseks.

meals.name: Paksud pannkoogid vaarikamoosiga
meals.description: Pehmed, kohevad pannkoogid, mille peale läheb lusikatäis vaarikamoosi ja jogurtit. Kohevus tuleb küpsetuspulbrist ja jogurtist.

meals.name: Kaera-banaanipannkoogid mustikamoosiga
meals.description: Pehmed kaerahelbepannkoogid, mis saavad magususe küpsest banaanist. Peale tuleb mustikamoos ja natuke jogurtit.

meals.name: Sushikauss tofu ja avokaadoga
meals.description: Kleepuv sushiriis, krõbedalt praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk. Riis saab äädika ja suhkruga õige sushimaitse.

meals.name: Munakimbap
meals.description: Koreapärane riisirull kuldse munaomleti, porgandi ja kurgiga. Nori sisse keeratud ja seesamiõliga läikima löödud.

meals.name: Sushiburrito kanaga
meals.description: Suur nori-riisirull krõbedalt praetud kana, avokaado ja kapsaga. Vürtsikas majoneesikaste seob kõik kokku.

meals.name: Tofu sushikauss
meals.description: Kuldseks praetud tofu, kleepuv äädikariis, krõmpsuv kurk ja kreemjas avokaado. Kõik läheb ühte kaussi nagu sushi, aga ilma rullimiseta.

meals.name: Kana riisipallid
meals.description: Pehmed noriga ümbritsetud riisipallid mahlase teriyaki-kanaga. Kana saab pannil klaasitud, riis vormitud märgade kätega.

meals.name: Munarull riisiga
meals.description: Õhuke pehme omlett rullitakse kokku äädikariisi ja kurgiribadega ning mähitakse noriga. Lõika viiludeks ja kasta sojakastmesse.

meals.name: Tofu sushikauss
meals.description: Kuldseks praetud tofu, kreemjas avokaado ja krõmpsuv kurk maitsestatud sushiriisil. Nori ribad toovad päris sushi maitse.

meals.name: Kimbap-stiilis munarullid
meals.description: Nori lehtedesse keeratud riis, õrn munaomlett ning kurgi- ja porgandiribad. Lõikad rullid ringideks ja söö käega.

meals.name: Teriyaki kana onigiri
meals.description: Kolmnurksed riisipallid mahlase teriyaki kana ja majoneesiga. Nori riba hoiab need käes koos ja seesam lisab krõmpsu.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidrunikartulitega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee küüslaugu ja tilliga, kõrval kuldsed sidrunikartulid. Kõik valmib ühel plaadil ja sobib hästi pidulauda.

meals.name: Suvikõrvitsalasanje ricottaga
meals.description: Kreemjas ricotta, õrn suvikõrvits ja sulanud mozzarella tomatikastme kihtide vahel. Pealt kuldne juustukoorik.

meals.name: Täidetud paprika fetaga
meals.description: Magusad ahjupaprikad riisi, kikerherneste ja fetaga. Tomatikaste hoiab täidise pehme ja aromaatse.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe sidrunivõiga
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni-tilli võiga, kõrval kuldsed ahjukartulid ja rohelised spargliheinad. Kõik küpseb ühel ahjuplaadil.

meals.name: Juustune spinatilasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja spinati-ricotta täidise, tomatikastme ja sulanud mozzarellaga. Pealt kuldne ja venivjuustune.

meals.name: Täidetud paprikad riisi ja fetaga
meals.description: Magusad ahjupaprikad, mis on täidetud riisi, kikerherneste ja murenenud fetaga. Tomatine ja ürdine täidis imeb küpsedes mahlad endasse.

meals.name: Ahjulõhe juurviljadega
meals.description: Mahlane lõhefilee sidruni- ja tillivõiga, kõrval kuldseks röstitud kartul ja porgand. Kõik küpseb koos ühel plaadil, nii et lõunalaud saab kiiresti valmis.

meals.name: Spinati-ricotta lasanje
meals.description: Kihiline lasanje kreemja ricotta, spinati ja sulanud mozzarellaga tomatikastme sees. Pealt kuldne ja krõbeda juustukoorikuga.

meals.name: Ahjukalapirukas
meals.description: Pehme turska-, herne- ja purulaugukaste kartulipuderi all. Pealt juustune ja kuldse koorikuga.

meals.name: Kana-wokk nuudlitega
meals.description: Kuumal pannil kiiresti kuldseks praetud kanafilee, krõmpsuvad köögiviljad ja läikivad nuudlid ingveri-kalakastme glasuuris.

meals.name: Pähklinuudlid kanaga
meals.description: Siidised riisinuudlid, õrn kanafilee ja krõbe kurk kreemja maapähklikastmega. Kaste tuleb kokku otse pannil mõne minutiga.

meals.name: Karrinuudlid kanaga
meals.description: Kollane kookoskarrikaste ümbritseb nuudleid, kanatükke ja magusaid herneid. Kõik valmib ühel pannil.

meals.name: Kana-wokk munanuudlitega
meals.description: Mahlased kanatükid ja krõmpsuvad köögiviljad munanuudlitel, mis on kaetud kleepuva mesise kastmega. Wokis kiiresti kõrgel kuumusel küpsetatud, nagu restoranis.

meals.name: Kana pad thai
meals.description: Pehmed riisinuudlid, kuldne kana ja munaga hautatud köögiviljad hapukas-magusas kastmes. Peale puistatud röstitud maapähkleid ja pigistatud laimi.

meals.name: Kookos-karriwokk kanaga
meals.description: Kreemjas kookoskaste karripulbriga ümbritseb kanatükke, brokolit ja riisinuudleid. Kiire wokipann annab köögiviljadele kerge krõmpsu.

meals.name: Kana-wokk nuudlitega
meals.description: Mahlane kanafilee, krõmpsuvad köögiviljad ja läikivad munanuudlid ingveri-küüslaugukastmes. Wokis kiirelt kuumalt üle tule keeratud, nagu restoranis.

meals.name: Maapähklikaste kana-wokk
meals.description: Kreemjas maapähklikaste mähib endasse õhukesed kanaribad, riisinuudlid ja krõbeda kapsa. Laimimahl ja koriander toovad värskust.

meals.name: Tai basiilikukana nuudlitega
meals.description: Tulisevõitu kanakints, rohelised oad ja värske basiilik nuudlite peal. Kiirelt kuumal pannil keedetud, kastmes on kala- ja laimimaitse.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid, suitsutatud tofu ja kreemjas taimne hapukoorekaste. Maitse jääb vanaema salati moodi, till annab värskuse.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuste austerseentega
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat krõbedaks praetud suitsupaprikaseentega ja terava sinepise hapukoorekastmega. Seened annavad suitsuka maitse nagu kala.

meals.name: Ahjukartulisalat suitsuporgandiga
meals.description: Ahjus kuldseks küpsenud kartulid ja suitsupaprikas marineeritud porgandilindid, mis meenutavad suitsukala. Peale tuleb hapukoorekaste kapparite ja tilliga.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid, suitsune tofu ja kreemjas hapukoorekaste marineeritud kurgi ning tillega. Maitseb nagu vanaema suitsukalasalat.

meals.name: Ahjukartulisalat kikerhernestega
meals.description: Kuldsed ahjukartulid ja suitsupaprikas krõbedad kikerherned kreemja hapukoorekastmega. Murulauk toob värskuse.

meals.name: Kartulisalat praeseentega
meals.description: Soe kartulisalat kuldseks praetud seente ja hapukoorega. Nori leht annab kerge mereanni maitse, mis tuletab meelde suitsukala.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat suitsutofuga
meals.description: Pehmed soojad kartulid, suitsutatud tofu ja hapukurk kreemja taimse hapukoore kastmes. Maitseb nagu vanaema kartulisalat, kala asemel on pannil kuldseks praetud tofu.

meals.name: Kartulisalat suitsuporgandi ja kašukastmega
meals.description: Ahjus röstitud suitsused porgandiribad soojade kartulitega ja siidjas kašukaste, mis asendab hapukoort. Suitsune maitse tuleb suitsupaprikast ja sojakastmest.

meals.name: Soe kartulisalat kikerhernetega
meals.description: Soojad kartulid ja krõbedaks praetud suitsused kikerherned, mille merelise noodi annab noriileht. Peale tuleb hapukoorelaadne sidruniga jogurtikaste ning redis ja till.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Pehme punase läätse ja tomatikastmega spagetid, mis maitsevad nagu tavaline bolognese. Porgand sulab kastmesse ära ja kõige peale tuleb riivjuust.

meals.name: Läätsetortillad juustuga
meals.description: Soojad tortillad pehme maitsestatud läätsetäidise, sulanud juustu ja krõbeda kurgiga. Täidis valmib pannil mõne minutiga.

meals.name: Magus läätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas kookospiimaga läätsekarri pehme bataadiga, õrna maitsega ja lastele sobiv. Punane lääts keeb kastmes ise pudruks.

meals.name: Läätse-tomatipasta
meals.description: Pehme punase läätse ja porgandiga tomatikaste, mis meenutab Bolognese'i, kuid on täiesti lihavaba. Kaste hautub kiiresti pehmeks ja kleepub hästi pasta külge.

meals.name: Läätsekotletid jogurtikastmega
meals.description: Kuldse krõbeda koorikuga kotletid porgandi ja läätsega, serveeritud jahutava kurgijogurtiga. Sobivad hästi näpuampsuks.

meals.name: Kookosläätsekarri riisiga
meals.description: Kreemjas ja õrna maitsega karri punase läätse, porgandi ja roheliste hernestega. Kookospiim teeb selle pehmeks ja lastele sobivaks.

meals.name: Läätsebolognese spagettidega
meals.description: Pehme punane läätsekaste tomati ja porgandiga, mis meenutab klassikalist hakkliha-Bolognese't. Peale riivid juustu.

meals.name: Läätsekotletid jogurtikastmega
meals.description: Kuldse krõbeda koorikuga läätsekotletid sulanud juustuga. Kõrvale tuleb jahe kurgi-jogurtikaste.

meals.name: Kreemjas läätse-porgandisupp
meals.description: Siidiselt pehme oranž supp kookospiima ja punaste läätsedega. Keeb ühes potis valmis ja läheb hästi koos võileivaga.
